name: Data For Dummies
tagline: A calm, focused mobile learning companion for people who want practical data skills without the jargon.

slides.title: Learning data should feel achievable
slides.lead: The app turns a broad, intimidating subject into a clear next step—on the device learners already carry.

items.title: Start without friction
items.body: Browse the course catalogue and free lessons before committing.

items.title: Learn at your pace
items.body: Read focused lessons, use practical tools, and continue where you stopped.

items.title: See real progress
items.body: Saved completion, course progress, and certificates make momentum visible.

slides.title: One product, four learner moments
slides.lead: The experience adapts to intent—from a curious visitor to a committed Pro learner managing their account.

items.title: Guest explorer
items.goal: “Show me whether this is for me.”
items.value: Catalogue, course detail, lesson previews and free learning paths.

items.title: Signed-in learner
items.value: Saved progress, continue-learning cues and account-aware navigation.

items.title: Existing Pro learner
items.value: Entitlement-aware lessons, tools and certificate access.

items.title: Account owner
items.value: Settings, password reset, privacy links, sign-out and deletion.

slides.title: From curiosity to a completed course
slides.lead: Every step is explicit, recoverable and designed for small-screen focus.
slides.footer: A web learner can continue in the app with the same account

slides.title: Everything needed to learn—nothing noisy
slides.lead: The information architecture stays familiar: Home, Courses, Tools and Account are always one tap away.

slides.title: A complete account lifecycle
slides.lead: People can enter, recover, understand and leave the service without getting trapped.

slides.title: The app protects the learner’s context
slides.lead: Native boundaries are strict where identity and navigation matter most; web content is admitted only on purpose.

groups.title: Secure sessions
items: Tokens stored in secure device storage
Sensitive state cleared on sign out

groups.title: Hardened WebView
items: External URLs open outside the app

groups.title: Privacy controls
items: No invented social or tracking claims

slides.title: Native where it matters. Reuse where it helps.
slides.lead: A React Native shell delivers app-grade identity, navigation and state while selected long-form content remains safely reusable.

layers.title: Android + iOS
layers.body: One React Native app with platform-specific packaging, icons and release settings.

layers.title: Native product shell
layers.body: Authentication, Home, Courses, Progress, Certificates, Tools and Account.

layers.title: Controlled web content
layers.body: Existing lesson and tool routes inside an allowlisted, hardened WebView.

layers.title: Existing backend
layers.body: The same account, content, entitlement and progress services.

slides.title: Release confidence is earned, not claimed
slides.lead: The product has passed repeatable engineering checks while keeping platform limitations explicit.
checks: Type, lint and automated tests passed
